_comment: Approved per-environment RAM1 budgets for the Teensy 4.1 firmware. Edit deliberately, in the same commit as the change that needs it, and record the reason in the owning change's review artifact. Never auto-update from a build. A string value means 'this environment's budget is identical to the named one'.

padding_floor_history.note: Reviewed 32-byte allowance for the accepted-interaction latch: two ITCM call sites to the FLASH-resident predicate inside the ITCM manager entries, plus the latch drive. ITCM stayed at 12 banks; locals free unchanged at 34,944 in teensy41-capture-serial.

teensy41-capture-serial.note: Default capture/acceptance env. ITCM unchanged at 12 banks (code 391,304 + padding 1,912). RAM1 variables 96,192 -> 96,160 and locals free 34,880 -> 34,912 by the S1.3 record-stop slot-identity diagnostic and the bounded identity-path counters: the mutable counters and the last-take identity live with the capture ring state in DTCM (sCaptureRing) while the counter-handling functions (recSlotIdentity, emitIdentityPathStats) are FLASH-placed (SC_MEM_ATTR), and the take identity is packed into one 32-bit word in the TrackCaptureInput TU rather than a Track member, so Track's pinned sizeof(384) is untouched. Net effect is 32 B of DTCM returned to the local allowance, not a cost. Recorded in openspec/changes/runtime-working-set-ownership/ARCHITECTURE-REVIEW.md (§ Recorded-slot -> persistence-target correctness). S4f.21 (2026-09-29) job-qualified Record-stop geometry: the manager now holds, per track, one owed bit plus the interval's own slot (9 B, 32 B of DTCM at the section granularity) so `masterLoopLength` and auto-align are adopted from the interval's **published** geometry rather than from the stop edge's prediction. The same slice moved `TrackManager::stopRecordingTrack`, `retainRecordStopGeometryObligation` and `servicePendingRecordStopGeometry` to FLASH, so ITCM code fell 391,240 -> 391,208 and padding rose 1,976 -> 2,008: 32 B of DTCM traded for 32 B of ITCM headroom. `itcm_bytes` (12 banks) and `padding_floor` are unchanged. Recorded in openspec/changes/runtime-working-set-ownership/S4F17-CUTOVER-PACKET.md (S17.3b).

teensy41.note: Plain env without SESSION_CAPTURE/PERF_TELEMETRY. Same 12-bank ITCM ceiling; padding 9,960 after the same extraction. The shared padding_floor warns if it ever approaches the boundary.
